title: Same Text, Different Prediction: Serving-Context Nondeterminism in Text Classifiers
summary: batch shape 变化在 bf16 下可导致高达 56.7 个百分点的概率漂移，即使标签不变也不能保证分数稳定——这对生产环境部署是严肃警告
body:
batch shape 变化在 bf16 下可导致高达 56.7 个百分点的概率漂移，即使标签不变也不能保证分数稳定——这对生产环境部署是严肃警告

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09111
summary_en: Text classifiers can produce significantly different predictions for identical inputs depending on serving context. Under bf16 precision, changes in batch shape cause probability drift of up to 56.7 percentage points. Even when predicted labels remain unchanged, confidence scores become unstable. This represents a serious warning for production deployment of machine learning models.
